name: Palimpsest Evidence Atlas
description: Machine-readable catalog of Palimpsest censorship, information-control, network-health, state-telemetry, and model-evaluation datasets.
cadence_semantics: Dataset cadence is the intended collection target, not a guaranteed website publication interval; artifact timestamps and evidence_state are authoritative.

datasets.name: Domestic Discourse Tightening Index
datasets.description: Ranks topics receiving censor attention in China Digital Times' curated deletion and directive feeds; it measures attention allocation, not a population deletion rate.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest code and derived fields; upstream rights retained

datasets.name: OONI Great Firewall signal
datasets.description: Windowed China blocking rates from openly published OONI measurements, with denominators and per-test evidence kept visible.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 source data

datasets.name: OONI bulk evidence warehouse
datasets.description: Hourly, country- and test-scoped replication of OONI JSONL evidence with byte budgets, checksums, resumable manifests, and privacy-minimized public rollups.

license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

datasets.name: Inside View
datasets.description: Controlled DNS comparisons from consented Globalping cloud probes in mainland China against independent control locations.

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest output; provider terms apply

datasets.name: BLEEDTHROUGH DNS-injector telemetry
datasets.description: Bounded external-vantage measurements of coarse DNS-injector response-process changes across declared Chinese network groups. Only the privacy-minimized v2 relay is public; target IPs, prefix samples, baselines, and probe-level observations remain private. A response transition is a measurement lead, not attribution of an actor or intent.

license.name: MIT for sanitized Palimpsest method and aggregates; upstream RIPE terms apply

datasets.name: Cloudflare passive TCP telemetry

datasets.name: In-path interference

datasets.name: IODA outage evidence

license.name: Upstream terms; Palimpsest derived output MIT

datasets.name: net4people event stream

datasets.name: Circumvention demand

datasets.name: Journalist erasure trail

datasets.name: China economic observation ledger
datasets.description: Aggregate-only, bitemporal economic observations with separate reference-period, source-release and Palimpsest-collection clocks, revision identity and exact evidence hashes. The current public ledger is narrow and mostly CFETS-derived; it is an auditable interchange, not a complete national activity index or an estimate of true GDP.
datasets.freshness_semantics: Event-time freshness advances only when a new or revised observation is appended. It does not claim that the scheduled collector was healthy on every poll.

license.name: Mixed rights: official-source data rights retained; Palimpsest code, schema and metadata MIT

datasets.name: China named-series forecast and backtest audit
datasets.description: Deterministic pseudo-real-time backtests over the bitemporal observation ledger, scoring first-release and latest-revised outcomes separately. Every model, failed fold and promotion gate remains public; named-series forecasts stay null until frozen history, independence, revision and calibration gates all pass. This is not an economy-wide activity forecast.
datasets.freshness_semantics: Derived event time follows the newest checksum-validated ledger collection clock; it is not a collector-health heartbeat.
sources: Palimpsest bitemporal China economic observation ledger

license.name: Mixed rights: upstream observations retained; Palimpsest forecast code, schema and metadata MIT

license.name: MIT for Palimpsest synthesis and metadata; upstream publisher rights retained

datasets.name: Palimpsest Investigations Desk

datasets.name: Palimpsest Evidence Mesh
